artifacts.rights_basis: The complete delivery explicitly states Rights: Public Domain and identifies the 1895 T. & T. Clark printing. That historical edition is public domain in the United States; CCEL attribution and delivery header remain unchanged.

edition.publication: Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1895; complete CCEL plain-text delivery, as its header identifies the print basis
edition.title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, volume 8, CCEL text

work.author: Philip Schaff and Henry Wace
work.description: The eighth volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Basil of Caesarea's letters, the Hexaemeron, and On the Spirit in English, with the volume editors' prolegomena. Its container identity remains distinct from Basil's own works printed within it.
work.title: A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Volume VIII
